note: Skin repair for the Sketchfab glb export of "UZI | First Person Animations (2026 Remake)" by 1Matzh (73266e9f1eb949b69a3ab11d8f636048). The export shares one skin between the Background plane, the arms (Mesh_*) and the gun (UZI_*), with inverse bind matrices computed for the Background plane (scale 710.5 x 357.8 x 372.0) and the other meshes' vertices stored as raw = -diag(scale - 101) * R * v, mirrored. Both matrices were solved on 2026-09-29 from the pack's source FBX (Sketchfab source archive: cluster Transform/TransformLink, mesh vertices matched to the glb within 2e-5): `vertex` maps the stored Mesh_*/UZI_* POSITION, NORMAL and TANGENT data into the skinned mesh node's space (metres, the FBX rig's space), `ibm_post` turns every inverse bind matrix into the inverse of the joint's true bind pose (IBM' = IBM @ ibm_post). Used by strip_glb.py --skin-fix and gltf_anim.py bake --skin-fix.
